resources.string: Online backup
Keep a copy of every trip online, in Google\'s Firebase in Montréal, Canada, without its GPS points. One purchase, no subscription.
Signed in as %1$s. Your trips upload by themselves after each change, when the phone is online. The Log has a line for each upload.
Sign out
Signed in as %1$s. Bought it already, on this phone or another? Restore it.
Purchase online backup
Purchase online backup · %1$s
On
Restore purchase
Backup unlocked. Your trips start uploading now.
Payment pending. The backup unlocks when Google Play says it is paid; press Restore purchase then.
Google Play cannot sell the backup on this phone right now.
That purchase belongs to another Dually backup account. Sign in with the Google account you used when you bought it.
That purchase was refunded, so it no longer unlocks the backup.
No purchase of the backup was found in this phone\'s Google Play account.
Unlocking did not work. If you paid, the purchase is kept: try Restore purchase. The Log says why.
This phone has no Google account to sign in with. Add one in the phone\'s settings, then try again.
Google Play has not confirmed the purchase yet. It is kept: press Restore purchase again in a few minutes.
Google could not be reached. Check the phone is online and try again.
Signing in did not work. Try again; the Log says why.
This copy of Dually was built without the cloud backup\'s settings.
Signed in as %1$s. Trips on this phone: %2$d. Trips from your other phones: %3$d. Merge them into one logbook?
Merge
Use only the backup\'s trips
Use only the backup\'s trips?
This phone\'s own trips are taken off it, and your logbook shows the trips from your other phones. A safety copy of this phone\'s trips is made first, under Your data.
Use the backup\'s trips
This phone now shows the trips from your online backup, and backs up from now on.
A change of yours was replaced
Your change to the trip of %1$s was replaced by a later change on %2$s. Open the trip to put yours back.
Merged. This phone\'s trips back up from now on, and your other phones\' trips show here too.
Delete my online backup and account
Delete your online backup and account?

Your trips are deleted from Dually\'s server, and your Dually account with them. The trips on this phone stay. Your purchase stays with your Google Play account: sign in again later and press Restore purchase.
Delete
Not while a trip is being recorded. End the trip, then try again.
That did not work; the trips on this phone were not changed. The Log says why.
Your online backup could not be reached. Check the phone is online and try again.
Your account could not be deleted. Check the phone is online and try again.
Your online backup and account are deleted. The trips on this phone stay.
